title: Status filter
description: One control in all its states: closed, open, and the per-role default. Captured from the real expenses list, opened by the scan itself.

items.md:
## StatusFilter

A `Select` above the expenses table.

| Role | Default |
|---|---|
| Employee | All statuses |
| Manager | All statuses |
| Finance | **Approved** (what they act on) |

Options follow the lifecycle order. Changing it filters the table in place, no reload.

![The list it filters](stavy:expenses?role=finance)
